parts.label: (a)
parts.text: State two uses of capacitors in electrical circuits, other than for the smoothing of direct current.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text:

$$\text{charge} = \dots\dots\dots\dots\dots\dots\dots\dots\dots\dots\,\mu\text{C}$$

parts.label: (b)(iii)
parts.text:

1. a capacitor of capacitance $C$,
$$\text{charge} = \dots\dots\dots\dots\dots\dots\dots\dots\dots\dots\,\mu\text{C}$$
